name: Le cabinet d'anatomie
camera: from the landing door, facing east into the anatomy cabinet (the studio lies north = left)

setting.walls: deep oxblood-red walls with dark mahogany display cases
setting.landmark: a tall mahogany-and-glass case at the back with a friendly teaching skeleton, under a big brass chandelier
setting.light: daylight from two tall windows on the right plus the chandelier
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: A VAIN ("VEHN") moustached bodybuilder admires a blue VEIN on his flexed arm in a hand mirror.
A little yellow toy CRANE ("KRAHN") lowers a dinosaur fossil SKULL into a glass display case.
The teaching SKELETON ("skuh-LEHT") on its wheeled stand wears sunglasses and a striped scarf and waves hello.
Two mice give a marble BUST in a woolly hat a BOOST ("BEWST") up onto its pedestal.
A ginger kitten MEWS ("MEWSKL") proudly as it flexes a tiny MUSCLE in a striped strongman leotard.
A mouse plays a little pipe ORGAN ("or-GAHN") whose pipes are shaped like body ORGANS: a heart and two lungs.
A mother hippo pats her round STOMACH after lunch while her baby calls 'MA!' ("ehs-toh-MAH") for more.
A girl RAN ("RAN") off across the floor hugging a pink bean-shaped plush KIDNEY toy.
A bear blows one deep 'FWAH!' ("FWAH") on his tuba, and a soft plush LIVER toy sits in its bell.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le cabinet d'anatomie in the B17_cabinet building, first floor (east). Camera: from the landing door, facing east into the anatomy cabinet (the studio lies north = left).
Setting: deep oxblood-red walls with dark mahogany display cases; floor: dark walnut parquet. Landmark: a tall mahogany-and-glass case at the back with a friendly teaching skeleton, under a big brass chandelier. Light: daylight from two tall windows on the right plus the chandelier. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the tall oak door behind, in the near left foreground (way to Le palier); an open arch on the LEFT wall with bright skylit wheat-yellow walls beyond (way to L'atelier de l'illustrateur).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- left, middle distance: A VAIN bodybuilder admires a blue VEIN on his arm in a hand mirror.
- left, foreground: A little toy CRANE lowers a dinosaur SKULL into a glass display case.
- centre-left, middle distance: The teaching SKELETON wears sunglasses and a striped scarf, waving hello.
- centre, foreground: Two mice give a marble BUST in a woolly hat a BOOST up onto its pedestal.
- centre-right, middle distance: A kitten MEWS proudly as it flexes a tiny MUSCLE in a strongman leotard.
- right, foreground: An organist plays a little pipe ORGAN whose pipes are shaped like body ORGANS: heart, lungs, kidneys.
- right, middle distance: A hippo pats her round STOMACH after lunch and her baby calls 'MA!' for more.
- far right, foreground: A bean-shaped KIDNEY with little legs RAN off the anatomy chart and across the floor.
- far right, middle distance: A tuba player blows one deep 'FWAH!' and a soft toy LIVER pops out of the tuba's bell.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
